result:
**Verdict: approve all three.** I found no blockers. I looked at the actual files, but only at the size the viewer showed them (about 1536×1024) and couldn't zoom in. Any check of the edges at the single-pixel level is still open.

**01-dashboard-final.png: APPROVE**
- **Screen fit:** the screen sits square inside the bezel. The left sidebar, top tiles, gauge card and media card all fit with no clipping, and the gap between the content and the frame is even all round. I can't see any halo or seam around the screen.
- **Cluster blur:** the blur on the instrument cluster matches the steering wheel and wiper stalk, so it reads as natural depth of field. No malformed numbers can be read. The edge of the blur zone where it meets the sharp silver trim (around x≈380) looks believable.
- **Text:** the speed gauge reads cleanly (dial 0–180, inner rev scale 0–7, 52 km/h, 1560 rpm, gear D4).
- **Minor: tiny labels.** Several labels are only about 6–7 px tall and illegible at this framing: the weather line, the sunrise/sunset times, the "CarLink" / "YouTube Music" tile labels and the 9,1 subtitle. The "Налаштування…" tile label seems to fill the whole tile width, so check it at 100% for overflow.
- **Minor: time of day.** The clock says 15:08 and the screen shows sunset at 18:24, but the sky is at dusk. Most people won't notice, but it doesn't add up.
- **Minor: different screen frames.** This frame has MIC/RST and hardware buttons on the left edge; the frames in 02 and 03 have none. You said brand consistency isn't a blocker, so this isn't one.

**02-fuel-final.png: APPROVE**
- **Screen fit:** a straight-on shot with the screen square in the frame. The Oil card on the right and the bottom averages bar sit fully inside the screen with no clipping. The edges look clean.
- **Numbers:** the data is consistent. Gas 18.0 of 33.6 L is 54%, petrol 24 of 60 L is 40%, and the ranges (180 km at 10 L/100 km, 300 km at 8 L/100 km) work out.
- **Minor: weak percentage text.** The grey "40%" over the yellow fill is low contrast where the two overlap. That comes from the app screenshot, not the compositing.
- **Minor: top crop.** The top edge of the image cuts through the hazard button and the vents. It's acceptable, but the framing is a bit tight.

**03-trips-final.png: APPROVE**
- **Angle:** the screen content tilts the same way as the frame. The bottom edge slopes down to the right (about 690 to 745 px) like the frame's lower edge, and the right edge narrows toward the bottom consistently. The text baselines tilt by the same amount, and nothing looks sheared or warped.
- **Bottom of the screen:** the fourth chart is partly visible, as you intended. The "Максимальна швидкість 45" row on the left sits right on the bottom edge but isn't cut off.
- **Cluster blur:** the defocused cluster at the left blends with the out-of-focus left side of the picture, and no numbers can be read.
- **Minor: two different average speeds.** The speed chart gives an average of 38 km/h, which matches 9.5 km in 15 minutes, but the stats panel says 40 km/h. This comes from the app, not the compositing; fix it in the app if the mockup is meant to be checked closely.
- **Minor: model label.** Only this image has the "CC3" label on the frame. That isn't a blocker.

No edits were made.
